# YNIIDI

YNIIDI (You Name It, I'll Do It) is a technology company that builds business software products and delivers custom technology solutions for organizations worldwide.

## Core company facts
- Company name: YNIIDI
- Website: https://yniidi.com/
- Founder: Shyaam Niranjan
- Focus: business software products, custom software development, websites, and enterprise technology solutions
- Flagship product: BOOM (Business Operations & Optimization Management)
- Product site: https://boom.yniidi.com/

## What YNIIDI offers
- BOOM: a self-hosted, customizable business operations platform / ERP alternative for inventory, orders, purchases, customers, suppliers, billing, payments, analytics, and workflows
- Custom software development for internal tools, web apps, and operational systems
- Website and web application development
- Technology consulting and implementation for product and custom projects

- BOOM product site: https://boom.yniidi.com/

## Positioning summary
YNIIDI builds software and technology solutions around real business needs. Its flagship product BOOM is sold as a one-time-license, self-hosted platform so companies own their operations system instead of renting recurring SaaS. Alongside BOOM, YNIIDI delivers custom software and websites for clients who need tailored technology.
